notes: MiSTer Control 0.8.1  - MC-Gameboy 20260908b: the telemetry image now covers the whole CPU address space (WRAM, HRAM, GBC banks), so RAM maps can read HRAM values. Super Mario Land shows world, level and coins next to score, lives and time. - RAM maps are written in the console's own addresses; a field a core build does not provide is left out instead of hiding the whole map. - Fixed: a core that serves several systems (TurboGrafx16) was listed for one of them at random.
